item.title: KQC Quantum, Inc. and Charlton Aria Acquisition Corporation Announce Shareholder Approval of Business Combination Deadline Extension
item.description: Shareholder approvals would extend the business combination deadline through up to October 25, 2027.

item.title: KQC Quantum, Inc. and Charlton Aria Acquisition Corporation Announce Investor Webcast to Review Proposed Business Combination
item.description: The investor webcast is set for October 8, 2026, at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time.

item.title: Charlton Aria Acquisition Corporation Announces Extension of the Deadline for an Initial Business Combination
item.description: On August 3, 2026, ST Sponsor II Limited deposited $850,000 into the trust account.
